eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Millard, UT; at 3:23 PM on AUG 2, 2026 Effective until 3:23 PM AUG 3, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Millard/Sheriff: Widemouth 2 fire, Mandatory evacuation for Fillmore from 500 S, East of Hwy 99 extending south to 1600 S. Life-threatening, fast-changing conditions. Leave now and avoid the area. Leave immediately by the designated route. Take only what you have already prepared by the door. Do not stop to gather additional belongings.
